description:
As a user
  I want to login and logout of the Sample App
  So that I can verify authentication functionality works correctly

elements.name: Login form is displayed on page load

steps.name: I navigate to the Sample App page
the username input should be visible
the password input should be visible
the login button should be visible with text "Log In"

elements.name: User is logged out by default

steps.name: I navigate to the Sample App page
the status label should show "User logged out."
I navigate to the Sample App page
I enter username "testuser" and password "pwd"
I click the login button
the status label should show "Welcome, testuser!"
the button should show "Log Out"

elements.name: Log Out button appears after successful login

steps.name: I navigate to the Sample App page
I enter username "testuser" and password "pwd"
I click the login button
the button should show "Log Out"
I navigate to the Sample App page
I enter username "testuser" and password "pwd"
I click the login button
I click the login button
the status label should show "User logged out."
I navigate to the Sample App page
I enter username "testuser" and password "wrongpassword"
I click the login button
the status label should contain "Invalid username/password"
I navigate to the Sample App page
I clear the username field and enter password "pwd"
I click the login button
the status label should not contain "Welcome"

name: Sample App

description:
As a user
  I want to verify values in a dynamic table with changing column positions
  So that I can confirm the application correctly displays process data

elements.name: Table is displayed with correct headers

steps.name: I navigate to the Dynamic Table page
the task manager table should be visible
the table should have a "CPU" column header
the table should have a "Name" column header

elements.name: Chrome process is present in the table

steps.name: I navigate to the Dynamic Table page
the Chrome process should be listed in the table

elements.name: Chrome CPU value in table matches the label

steps.name: I navigate to the Dynamic Table page
the Chrome CPU value in the table should match the yellow label

elements.name: Chrome CPU label is displayed below the table

steps.name: I navigate to the Dynamic Table page
the Chrome CPU label should be visible below the table

name: Dynamic Table

description:
As a user
  I want to handle browser alert, confirm, and prompt dialogs
  So that I can verify the application correctly manages native browser dialogs

elements.name: Alert, Confirm and Prompt buttons are displayed

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
the Alert button should be visible
the Confirm button should be visible
the Prompt button should be visible

elements.name: Alert dialog is handled when Alert button is clicked

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
I click the Alert button
the alert dialog should be accepted

elements.name: Confirm dialog is accepted when OK is clicked

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
I accept the confirm dialog
I click the Confirm button
the Confirm button should still be visible

elements.name: Confirm dialog is dismissed when Cancel is clicked

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
I dismiss the confirm dialog
I click the Confirm button
the Confirm button should still be visible

elements.name: Prompt dialog responds with a custom value

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
I respond to the prompt with "MyCustomResponse"
I click the Prompt button
the Prompt button should still be visible

elements.name: Prompt dialog is cancelled with null response

steps.name: I navigate to the Alerts page
I cancel the prompt dialog
I click the Prompt button
the Prompt button should still be visible

name: Alerts
